question: Whether the Delta-BHC Study provision establishes enforceable numeric discharge limits for delta-BHC (subject to exceedance comparison), or instead establishes only procedural planning, sampling, and report-only monitoring obligations without applicable numeric effluent limitations.
semantic_arguments: Target span requires submitting a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water; adjacent text completes the location as source water intake and adds plan-approval, timing, and quarterly sampling conditions for permit years 2–5.
Adjacent text directs study results to be attached to DMR reports but does not state numeric effluent limits for delta-BHC in the visible Part I effluent characteristics.

Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from report-only monitoring; Purpose B requires determining applicable monitoring requirements; Purpose C requires classifying missing or non-numeric results without inferring compliance or violation.
Federal FY2025 applicability of any sampling obligation depends on permit effective date, plan approval status, and whether years 2–5 of the permit overlap the evaluation period.
notes: Formulated from the truncated target span and its adjacent structural context in PASSAGE.md. Does not resolve whether numeric limits exist elsewhere in the permit or whether FY2025 falls within the conditioned sampling schedule.
